gp_pit_radio_lines: Box this lap, box this lap, tires are gone.
Gap behind is two seconds and closing.
Watch the manhole cover in turn three.
Light rain on the harbor straight, careful.
You're purple in sector two. Keep it up.
Yellow flag at the hairpin, no passing.
Fuel is tight. Lift and coast, please.
Car ahead is struggling on the cobbles.
Brakes are hot. Ease off on the long run.
Push now, push now, this is your window.
Safety car out. Stay close, stay calm.
Checkered flag. Get it home in one piece.
drone_pilot_tips: Fly low over the rowhouses to stay off radar.
Gulls dive at drones. Hold your altitude steady.
Battery under twenty? Head for the nearest roof.
Harbor wind pushes you east. Correct early.
Tap boost on straights, never in tight alleys.
Shadows on the street show where you are.
Land on a water taxi roof for a quick recharge.
Steeple gaps are tight. Slow down to thread them.
Hold still to snap a photo. Shaky shots score low.
Lost signal? Your drone floats back to the pad.
octagon_announcer_lines: In the blue corner, sauced and ready!
In the red corner, extra crispy!
Round two! Somebody bring more ranch!
Oh, that one hurt the whole table!
He's down! The ref is counting!
Back on his feet! What a comeback!
That's a flying elbow off the booth!
Final round, leave it all on the plate!
carl_lines: Carl don't lose. Carl gets delayed.
You stepped in my parking spot, hon.
I been fighting since the stoop days.
My mother hits harder than you.
Let's settle this on the steps, pal.
I got a cousin for every block.
This jacket's older than you, kid.
Fine. You win. Don't tell nobody.
Rodney! Get over here and help!
rodney_lines: I don't do warmups. Warmups do me.
You beat Carl? Carl trips on air.
I eat lightning for breakfast, hon.
Hold my lemon ice for a second.
This is my corner. Find your own.
I've got moves you ain't seen yet.
Ow. Okay. That was a good one.
Rodney needs a nap after that.
Next time I'm bringing my sister.
lexington_stall_barks: Hot pit beef, sliced while you wait!
Fresh rye, still warm from the oven!
Pickles by the barrel, get 'em here!
Fried chicken, crunch you can hear!
Coddies two for a buck, hon!
Sweet potato pie, last few slices!
Smoked sausage on a soft roll!
Cold sodas, colder than the harbor!
Fresh oysters on ice, step right up!
